headline: The Board Moves Before the Games Begin
dek: No completed EFL fantasy week yet, but the latest preseason model has reshuffled the chase behind No. 1 and sharpened the opening matchup picture.

lead.title: Master Peyton Holds the Line as the Contender Order Shifts
lead.body: The EFL is still waiting for its first completed fantasy week of 2026, so there are no regular-season results to manufacture into a story. What has changed is the league's current preseason hierarchy. Master Peyton remains No. 1 with an 89.2 Power Score, but the order immediately behind has tightened: The Don's Soldiers has climbed one spot to No. 2 at 84.2, edging Kaaron Rodgers, which slips to No. 3 at 83.8. Defending champion Blaze Infantry remains fourth at 75.3. The movement is still projection-driven rather than earned through completed games, but it gives Week 1 a clearer shape: the favorite is holding steady, the challengers are separating themselves, and several franchises already face opening matchups capable of changing the board quickly once real scoring begins.

briefs.label: POWER MOVE
briefs.title: The Don's Soldiers Jumps Into the No. 2 Spot
briefs.body: The Don's Soldiers moved from third to second in the latest EFL model, posting an 84.2 Power Score behind a projected core led by Christian McCaffrey, Joe Burrow and Amon-Ra St. Brown. Kaaron Rodgers is now third at 83.8, leaving only four-tenths of a point between the two contenders. That is effectively a dead heat entering Week 1 and makes the first real scoring sample especially important.

briefs.label: FALLING STOCK
briefs.title: The Duke and LandsharkSC Take the Biggest Preseason Slides
briefs.body: The Duke falls two places from fifth to seventh, while LandsharkSC drops from ninth to eleventh. The Duke's opening assignment is the toughest of the two: a Week 1 matchup with top-ranked Master Peyton. LandsharkSC draws the newly elevated No. 2 team, The Don's Soldiers. Neither move reflects a completed loss, but both franchises enter the season with immediate opportunities to reverse the preseason trend.

briefs.label: MATCHUP WATCH
briefs.title: No. 1 Master Peyton Gets an Immediate Test From The Duke
briefs.body: Master Peyton opens against The Duke in one of the most consequential Week 1 pairings on the board. The league leader brings an 89.2 Power Score and an A+ projected lineup grade, while The Duke sits seventh at 72.6 with Bijan Robinson, Jalen Hurts and Chris Olave headlining the roster. A strong showing by the favorite would validate the preseason model; an upset would give the rankings their first real piece of evidence.

briefs.label: CHAMPION WATCH
briefs.title: Blaze Infantry Opens the Title Defense at No. 4
briefs.body: Blaze Infantry remains fourth in the current rankings with a 75.3 Power Score and opens against fifth-ranked Trash Pandas at 74.1. That 1.2-point separation makes it one of the tightest pairings among neighboring teams on the board. Until regular-season scoring begins, there are no completed matchup, waiver or trade results to overstate; for now, the defending champion's first assignment is simply to protect its position against the team directly behind it.
